messages:
Ana Martin: Heads up — putting together a short PRD for Optimize Toolkit v0.3 (batching / caching / quant recommendations). Want alignment on launch gating and customer-driven asks.
Mike Chen: Which customer asks are we prioritizing? Any blockers from infra?
Sophie Patel: Two high-priority requests from customers this week: 1) per-route quant profiles (they want aggressive q8 for embeddings but safer q4 for chat) 2) persistent KV cache across cold starts for dedicated pools.
Lisa Gomez: For launch gating I'd propose: - Acceptance: quality regression < 1.5% on eval set - Perf: 95th latency <= 250ms for 512-token typical route - Cost: <= 20% token cost reduction vs baseline
Jordan Lee: Also add: telemetry hooks + A/B toggles so we can rollback if hallucination rates climb. Need clear eval suites per-customer.
Ana Martin: Drafting ACs now — quick paste:
```
Acceptance criteria:
- Pass eval-suite v3 on all supported models (regression < 1.5%)
- Per-route quantization config supported via `quant_profile` in route config
- KV cache persists across GKE pod restarts for Dedicated (>= 95% hit resumption)
- Observability: token-level cost delta + 95/99 latency dashboards
- Rollout: canary at 5% traffic, automatic rollback on quality/regression alert
```
deploy-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/optimize-toolkit/pull/234 (ana/mini-prd)
Mike Chen: Nice — who owns the rollout runbook? I'd like a small checklist for infra steps (config migration, DB migration if needed).
Sophie Patel: I can own RFC review and run the eval suite. Timeline: aim for internal sign-off next Wed (2050012400), public canary the week after.
Jordan Lee: Need perf experiments to estimate cost delta per quant profile. I'll add a `perf/` job to the pipeline. Can we agree on stable perf harness (512/1024 tokens)?
Lisa Gomez: Edge-case: if quantized kernels OOM on some GPUs, fallback to fp16 automatically. Add `fallback: fp16` as required.
Ana Martin: Great. I'll update the PR with these ACs, timeline, and a small rollout/runbook draft. @Sophie please ping when eval runs done. Thanks! :thumbsup:
